    • findClosestPath

      public static ArrayList<Ville> findClosestPath(Ville ville1, Ville ville2, Player player, Ville wannaBeGare)
      Returns an ArrayList of strings that makes the shortest path between 2 villes, by also including the player owned routes. Can be used by GarePosFinder.
      Parameters:
      ville1 - 1st ville
      ville2 - 2nd ville
      player - the player to find the owned routes. Put null if player isn't needed
      wannaBeGare - used for the GarePosFinder, to try as a gare without changing the ville structure
      Returns:
      the villes to get to in order to get the shortest path
